title: Attracts a lot of floor stuff.
text:
Attracts a lot of floor stuff.. By "floor stuff" I mean stuff that ends up on the floor from normal, household use. A crap of a wood chip, cat hair, lint, human hair, etc. You get the idea.

Because of the material, it can get pretty hard to clean. I've tossed this in the washer a couple times but the contents remain there. I have to tug at them to get them off.

At least it can absorb a few splashes of water. But when my kid has a full tub? Forget it.
